A glowing white overlay highlights the specific eye area to emphasize the anatomical focus. (3) She introduces a green Thermage eye treatment tip, holding it close to her right eye to demonstrate the application area. Her hand gestures are precise and clinical, pointing at the thin skin of the eyelid. (4) A split-screen comparison appears, showing two close-up images of eyes labeled with different treatments in Traditional Chinese text. One eye has a white arc above the brow, while the other focuses on the eyelid skin. She wears a gold ring and a watch, conveying a professional and polished appearance.
